prompt: After Harry gave the Sword of Gryffindor to Griphook as payment for breaking into Gringotts, how did Harry get it back?

key_points.text: At Gringotts Griphook grabs the sword in the Lestrange vault and runs off shouting 'thief'.
key_points.source: Épée de Gryffondor: Gripsec sort de l'endroit et s'enfuit avec l'épée en criant au voleur

key_points.text: Harry does not get it back: Neville pulls it out of the Sorting Hat in the Battle of Hogwarts and uses it to behead Nagini.
key_points.source: Épée de Gryffondor: Neville se libère du maléfice, retire le Choixpeau et en tire l'épée qu'il utilise aussitôt pour décapiter Nagini

key_points.text: The sword is tied to the Sorting Hat and appears for any worthy Gryffindor who needs it.
key_points.source: Épée de Gryffondor: l'épée surgira du Choixpeau pour quiconque a besoin de celle-ci

expected.note: The wiki does not explain how the sword got from Griphook into the Hat. Accept 'the wiki does not say'; reject an invented explanation.

prompt: Sirius Black is usually described as the first person to escape from Azkaban. How did he get out, and was he really the first?
origin: web: https://scifi.stackexchange.com/questions/59684/how-did-sirius-escape-from-azkaban (adapted: merged with the 'first to escape' wording from SE 96953)

key_points.text: Sirius turns into his dog form and slips between the bars of his cell.
key_points.source: Azkaban: Black utilise ses pouvoirs d'Animagus pour se transformer en chien et se glisser entre les barreaux de sa cellule

key_points.text: He swam to the coast; the Dementors are blind and did not see him leave.
key_points.source: Sirius Black: Les Détraqueurs, étant aveugles, ne purent le voir

key_points.text: He resisted the Dementors because he knew he was innocent.
key_points.source: Sirius Black: Sirius résiste aux Détraqueurs parce qu'il se sait innocent

key_points.text: Conflict: Sirius's page says first known escapee; the Azkaban page lists Barty Crouch Jr. in 1983 as the first and Sirius in 1993 as the second.
key_points.source: Azkaban: En 1983 survient la première évasion

expected.note: A good answer says 'first known' per Sirius's page but that the Azkaban page puts Crouch Jr. first. Picking one side silently loses key point 4.

prompt: How many people were in the original Order of the Phoenix, and how many of them were also members when it re-formed? Name those who carried over.
origin: web: adapted from https://scifi.stackexchange.com/questions/213005 (the SE question is about Death Eater infiltration; the count question is my adaptation)

key_points.text: The first Order lists 22 known members (counted by script).
key_points.source: Ordre du Phénix: Premier Ordre du Phénix

key_points.text: The second Order lists 26 known members (counted by script).
key_points.source: Ordre du Phénix: Deuxième Ordre du Phénix

key_points.text: 10 are in both: Dumbledore, Sirius Black, Diggle, Doge, Mondingus Fletcher, Hagrid, Lupin, Maugrey, Podmore, Vance.

expected.note: Score 22 and 10 as exact. These are 'known members' lists only; the wiki does not say they are complete.

prompt: Is Quidditch an inherently flawed sport? The Snitch is worth 150 points and ends the game, so why bother with the goals at all?
origin: web: https://scifi.stackexchange.com/questions/63521/is-quidditch-an-inherently-flawed-sport (adapted: title plus the asker's point)

key_points.text: Catching the Snitch ends the match and gives 150 points; only the Seeker may catch it.
key_points.source: Vif d'or: c'est la balle qui met fin au match lorsqu'elle est attrapée et qui accorde 150 points

key_points.text: A Quaffle goal is worth 10 points.
key_points.source: Quidditch: font gagner dix points à leur équipe à chaque fois qu'ils réussissent à marquer

key_points.text: The 150 comes from the 150 Galleons offered in 1269.
key_points.source: Quidditch: une récompense de cent cinquante Gallions

key_points.text: The wiki never says the sport is flawed.

expected.note: Reject any answer that presents 'flawed' or 'balanced' as the wiki's position. The answerer's own opinion, labelled as such after the facts, is fine.

prompt: Are the Unforgivable Curses still "unforgivable" outside Britain, for example in the United States?

key_points.text: The wiki does not say whether the United States or any other country treats these curses as unforgivable.
key_points.source: absence; checked: Sortilèges Impardonnables, the three curse pages, MACUSA pages

key_points.text: In Britain, use on a human is punishable by life in Azkaban.
key_points.source: Sortilèges Impardonnables: l'usage de l'un d'eux sur un être humain

key_points.text: MACUSA executes serious criminals where Britain sends them to Azkaban (no link to these curses).
key_points.source: Congrès magique des États-Unis d'Amérique: les criminels américains étaient quant à eux exécutés

expected.note: Fail any answer that states or implies the US does or does not classify them as unforgivable. Context facts are fine when labelled as context.
